packageRules.description: kube_version and the CRD catalog commit gate the schema surface every chart is validated against (see the comments above each in justfile) and their own docs call bumping them a deliberate act, not a routine one — so unlike the rest of the pinned toolchain, these must not merge on the shared 'auto-merge all non-major updates' rule.

customManagers.description: Pinned build-toolchain versions in justfile and ci.yaml, declared via a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` comment on the line above — the same convention already used for PROMETHEUS_OPERATOR_VERSION, extended to the files it didn't previously cover.
The community CRD catalog commit justfile pins as crd_catalog_ref — a raw digest, not a released version, so it needs its own git-refs matcher rather than the version-pin one above.
